scope: turning (right turns, left turns and U-turns, at intersections and elsewhere)

vocabulary.definition: A person who drives or has care and control of a vehicle on a HIGHWAY, including a person riding a bicycle when the rule applies to all vehicles.

A common and public highway, street, avenue, parkway, driveway, square, place, bridge, viaduct or trestle designed and intended for, or used by, the general public for the passage of vehicles, including the area between the lateral property lines.
The part of the HIGHWAY that is improved, designed or ordinarily used for vehicular traffic, excluding the shoulder.

The area embraced within the prolongation or connection of the lateral curb lines, or if none, the lateral boundary lines, of two or more HIGHWAYS that join one another at an angle, whether or not one HIGHWAY crosses the other.

Any portion of the ROADWAY at an INTERSECTION or elsewhere distinctly indicated for pedestrian crossing by signs or by lines or other markings on the surface, or the part of an INTERSECTION within the connections of the lateral lines of the sidewalks on opposite sides of the HIGHWAY.

Any portion of a ROADWAY designated by by-law of a municipality at an INTERSECTION or elsewhere, distinctly indicated for pedestrian crossing by signs on the HIGHWAY and lines or other markings on the surface of the ROADWAY as prescribed by the regulations.
A person sixteen years of age or older who is directing the movement of persons across a HIGHWAY and who is wearing the prescribed apparel and displaying a school crossing stop sign.
A person on foot, or a person in a wheelchair or other mobility device, using the HIGHWAY or a sidewalk.
A lane of the ROADWAY reserved for CYCLISTS by signs and pavement markings.
A HIGHWAY on which vehicular traffic is limited to movement in one direction, as indicated by signs.
A green arrow indication shown on a traffic control signal.

A flashing green light, or a green left-pointing arrow shown together with a green light, that gives drivers facing it a protected opportunity to turn left, go straight or turn right while opposing traffic faces a red light.
A sign or pavement arrow marking that designates the movements (left turn, right turn, straight through or a combination) permitted from a lane.

A centre lane of a ROADWAY, marked on both sides by a solid line and a broken line and with left-turn arrow markings pointing in opposite directions, reserved for left turns by traffic travelling in either direction.
A turn made so as to proceed in the opposite direction on the same HIGHWAY.
A manoeuvre to turn a vehicle around on a narrow ROADWAY by turning left, reversing while turning right, and then driving forward.
A circular INTERSECTION in which traffic travels counter-clockwise around a central island and entering traffic yields to traffic already in the circle.

rules.title: Turn only when it can be done safely
rules.when: about to turn left or right at an INTERSECTION OR into a private road or driveway
rules.action: first see that the turn can be made in safety
rules.statement: WHEN about to turn left or right at an INTERSECTION OR into a private road or driveway, the DRIVER MUST first see that the turn can be made in safety.

vague_terms.explanation: no gap, distance or time given

rules.title: Obey turn prohibition signs
rules.when: a sign at an INTERSECTION or other location prohibits a left turn OR a right turn OR all turns, during the times shown on the sign if any
rules.action: make the prohibited turn
rules.statement: WHEN a sign at an INTERSECTION or other location prohibits a left turn OR a right turn OR all turns, during the times shown on the sign if any, the DRIVER MUST NOT make the prohibited turn.
rules.penalty: Prohibited turn: fine and 2 demerit points.
rules.note: Some prohibition signs exempt particular vehicles (e.g. buses, bicycles) as shown on a tab.

rules.title: Slow down before turning
rules.when: approaching an INTERSECTION OR other place where the DRIVER intends to turn
rules.action: reduce speed before reaching the turn and turn at a safe, controlled speed
rules.statement: WHEN approaching an INTERSECTION OR other place where the DRIVER intends to turn, the DRIVER SHOULD reduce speed before reaching the turn and turn at a safe, controlled speed.

rules.title: Check mirrors, blind spots and all directions before turning
rules.when: about to turn
rules.action: check mirrors and blind spots and look in all directions for vehicles, CYCLISTS and PEDESTRIANS
rules.statement: WHEN about to turn, the DRIVER MUST check mirrors and blind spots and look in all directions for vehicles, CYCLISTS and PEDESTRIANS.

rules.title: Follow marked course for turning vehicles
rules.when: turning at an INTERSECTION where markings on the ROADWAY OR signs indicate the course to be followed by turning vehicles
rules.action: follow the course indicated
rules.statement: WHEN turning at an INTERSECTION where markings on the ROADWAY OR signs indicate the course to be followed by turning vehicles, the DRIVER MUST follow the course indicated.
rules.note: Based on HTA s.141 and the authority of traffic control signs and markings; exact subsection not confirmed.

rules.title: Signal before turning
rules.when: about to turn left or right OR change lanes to turn AND the operation of any other vehicle may be affected by the turn
rules.action: give a signal of the intention to turn that is plainly visible to the driver or operator of the other vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN about to turn left or right OR change lanes to turn AND the operation of any other vehicle may be affected by the turn, the DRIVER MUST give a signal of the intention to turn that is plainly visible to the driver or operator of the other vehicle.
rules.penalty: Fail to signal: fine and 2 demerit points.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say which vehicles count

rules.note: HTA s.142(1). The signal may be given by hand and arm or by a signal lamp.

rules.title: Hand signal for a left turn
rules.when: signalling a left turn by hand and arm
rules.action: extend the left hand and arm horizontally beyond the left side of the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN signalling a left turn by hand and arm, the DRIVER MUST extend the left hand and arm horizontally beyond the left side of the vehicle.

rules.title: Hand signal for a right turn
rules.when: signalling a right turn by hand and arm
rules.action: extend the left hand and arm out and upward beyond the left side of the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN signalling a right turn by hand and arm, the DRIVER MUST extend the left hand and arm out and upward beyond the left side of the vehicle.
rules.note: HTA s.142; see TURN-SIG-04 for the alternative available to cyclists.

rules.title: Cyclist right-turn signal with right arm
rules.when: signalling a right turn
rules.action: extend the right hand and arm horizontally beyond the right side of the bicycle
rules.statement: WHEN signalling a right turn, the CYCLIST MAY extend the right hand and arm horizontally beyond the right side of the bicycle.
rules.note: HTA s.142(6) allows this alternative for cyclists.

rules.title: Signal in good time but not too early
rules.when: intending to turn
rules.action: signal well before the turn and before slowing down, but not so early that other road users may think the DRIVER is turning at an earlier INTERSECTION or driveway
rules.statement: WHEN intending to turn, the DRIVER SHOULD signal well before the turn and before slowing down, but not so early that other road users may think the DRIVER is turning at an earlier INTERSECTION or driveway.

rules.title: Cancel signal after turning
rules.when: a turn has been completed AND the turn signal is still on
rules.action: turn off the signal
rules.statement: WHEN a turn has been completed AND the turn signal is still on, the DRIVER MUST turn off the signal.

rules.title: Right turn position
rules.when: intending to turn right at an INTERSECTION
rules.action: approach the INTERSECTION in the right-hand lane and make the turn as close as practicable to the right-hand curb or edge of the ROADWAY
rules.unless: a LANE DESIGNATION SIGN permits a right turn from another lane
rules.statement: WHEN intending to turn right at an INTERSECTION, the DRIVER MUST approach the INTERSECTION in the right-hand lane and make the turn as close as practicable to the right-hand curb or edge of the ROADWAY, UNLESS a LANE DESIGNATION SIGN permits a right turn from another lane.
rules.penalty: Improper right turn: fine and 2 demerit points.

rules.title: Right turn into the right lane
rules.when: completing a right turn onto a ROADWAY with more than one lane in the new direction
rules.action: turn into the right-hand lane and change lanes only after the turn is complete and it is safe
rules.statement: WHEN completing a right turn onto a ROADWAY with more than one lane in the new direction, the DRIVER MUST turn into the right-hand lane and change lanes only after the turn is complete and it is safe.
rules.note: Handbook instruction; the handbook also says not to swing wide.

rules.title: Do not swing wide on a right turn
rules.when: turning right
rules.action: swing wide into another lane before or during the turn
rules.statement: WHEN turning right, the DRIVER of a passenger vehicle MUST NOT swing wide into another lane before or during the turn.
rules.note: Handbook instruction; large trucks and buses may need to swing wide (see TURN-USER-01).

rules.title: Watch for cyclists on the right before a right turn
rules.when: about to turn right
rules.action: check the right mirror and right blind spot for CYCLISTS and let any CYCLIST approaching on the right go through before turning
rules.statement: WHEN about to turn right, the DRIVER MUST check the right mirror and right blind spot for CYCLISTS and let any CYCLIST approaching on the right go through before turning.

rules.title: Crossing a bicycle lane to turn right
rules.when: turning right across a BICYCLE LANE
rules.action: signal, check for CYCLISTS in the BICYCLE LANE and yield to them before crossing the BICYCLE LANE
rules.statement: WHEN turning right across a BICYCLE LANE, the DRIVER MUST signal, check for CYCLISTS in the BICYCLE LANE and yield to them before crossing the BICYCLE LANE.
rules.note: Handbook instruction; where the BICYCLE LANE line is broken near the intersection, the handbook indicates the driver may move into the lane to turn after yielding.

rules.title: Left turn position on a two-way road
rules.when: intending to turn left at an INTERSECTION from a HIGHWAY with traffic in both directions
rules.action: approach the INTERSECTION in the left-hand lane lawfully available to traffic in the DRIVER's direction, and turn so as to leave the INTERSECTION in a lane lawfully available to traffic moving in the new direction
rules.unless: a LANE DESIGNATION SIGN permits a left turn from another lane
rules.statement: WHEN intending to turn left at an INTERSECTION from a HIGHWAY with traffic in both directions, the DRIVER MUST approach the INTERSECTION in the left-hand lane lawfully available to traffic in the DRIVER's direction, and turn so as to leave the INTERSECTION in a lane lawfully available to traffic moving in the new direction, UNLESS a LANE DESIGNATION SIGN permits a left turn from another lane.
rules.penalty: Improper left turn: fine and 2 demerit points.

rules.title: Left turn from a one-way road
rules.when: intending to turn left at an INTERSECTION from a ONE-WAY HIGHWAY
rules.action: approach the INTERSECTION in the left-hand lane and turn as close as practicable to the left-hand curb or edge of the ROADWAY
rules.unless: a LANE DESIGNATION SIGN permits a left turn from another lane
rules.statement: WHEN intending to turn left at an INTERSECTION from a ONE-WAY HIGHWAY, the DRIVER MUST approach the INTERSECTION in the left-hand lane and turn as close as practicable to the left-hand curb or edge of the ROADWAY, UNLESS a LANE DESIGNATION SIGN permits a left turn from another lane.
rules.penalty: Improper left turn: fine and 2 demerit points.

rules.title: Yield to oncoming traffic when turning left
rules.when: turning left at an INTERSECTION
rules.action: yield the right of way to traffic approaching from the opposite direction that is in the INTERSECTION or so close to it as to constitute an immediate hazard
rules.statement: WHEN turning left at an INTERSECTION, the DRIVER MUST yield the right of way to traffic approaching from the opposite direction that is in the INTERSECTION or so close to it as to constitute an immediate hazard.
rules.penalty: Fail to yield: fine and 3 demerit points.

vague_terms.term: so close to it as to constitute an immediate hazard

rules.note: HTA s.141; oncoming traffic includes CYCLISTS.

rules.title: Left turn into the left lane
rules.when: completing a left turn onto a ROADWAY with more than one lane in the new direction
rules.action: turn into the left-most lane for traffic in the new direction and change lanes only after the turn is complete and it is safe
rules.statement: WHEN completing a left turn onto a ROADWAY with more than one lane in the new direction, the DRIVER MUST turn into the left-most lane for traffic in the new direction and change lanes only after the turn is complete and it is safe.

rules.title: Keep wheels straight while waiting to turn left
rules.when: stopped waiting to turn left
rules.action: keep the front wheels pointed straight ahead until it is safe to begin the turn
rules.statement: WHEN stopped waiting to turn left, the DRIVER MUST keep the front wheels pointed straight ahead until it is safe to begin the turn.
rules.note: Handbook instruction; the reason given is that a rear-end collision would otherwise push the vehicle into oncoming traffic.

rules.title: Waiting in the intersection to turn left
rules.when: intending to turn left at an INTERSECTION with traffic signals AND the light is green AND oncoming traffic prevents the turn
rules.action: move into the INTERSECTION, wait there, and complete the turn when oncoming traffic has cleared OR, if the light changes to amber or red, when it is safe
rules.statement: WHEN intending to turn left at an INTERSECTION with traffic signals AND the light is green AND oncoming traffic prevents the turn, the DRIVER MAY move into the INTERSECTION, wait there, and complete the turn when oncoming traffic has cleared OR, if the light changes to amber or red, when it is safe.
rules.note: Handbook guidance; the driver must still yield to PEDESTRIANS and to traffic lawfully in the INTERSECTION.

rules.title: Left turn into a driveway or private road
rules.when: turning left from a HIGHWAY into a private road or driveway
rules.action: yield the right of way to approaching traffic that is so close as to constitute an immediate hazard
rules.statement: WHEN turning left from a HIGHWAY into a private road or driveway, the DRIVER MUST yield the right of way to approaching traffic that is so close as to constitute an immediate hazard.

vague_terms.term: so close as to constitute an immediate hazard

rules.note: HTA s.141; exact subsection not confirmed.

rules.title: Stay in lane in a double turn
rules.when: turning from one of two or more side-by-side turning lanes
rules.action: stay in the same relative lane throughout the turn
rules.statement: WHEN turning from one of two or more side-by-side turning lanes, the DRIVER MUST stay in the same relative lane throughout the turn.
rules.note: Handbook guidance; whether stated as a command is not certain.

rules.title: Obey lane designation signs and arrows
rules.when: in a lane controlled by a LANE DESIGNATION SIGN
rules.action: make only the movement that the LANE DESIGNATION SIGN permits from that lane
rules.statement: WHEN in a lane controlled by a LANE DESIGNATION SIGN, the DRIVER MUST make only the movement that the LANE DESIGNATION SIGN permits from that lane.
rules.note: HTA s.154; a lane marked turn-only requires the driver in it to turn.

rules.title: Using a two-way left-turn lane
rules.when: travelling in either direction on a ROADWAY with a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE AND intending to turn left
rules.action: move into the TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE shortly before the turn and wait there to turn left
rules.statement: WHEN travelling in either direction on a ROADWAY with a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE AND intending to turn left, the DRIVER MAY move into the TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE shortly before the turn and wait there to turn left.

rules.title: Two-way left-turn lane not for travel or passing
rules.when: on a ROADWAY with a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE
rules.action: use the TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE to pass other vehicles or as a travel lane
rules.statement: WHEN on a ROADWAY with a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE, the DRIVER MUST NOT use the TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE to pass other vehicles or as a travel lane.

rules.title: Watch for vehicles turning from a two-way left-turn lane
rules.when: in a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE
rules.action: watch for vehicles entering the same lane from the opposite direction
rules.statement: WHEN in a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE, the DRIVER SHOULD watch for vehicles entering the same lane from the opposite direction.

rules.title: Turning on a green light
rules.when: turning left or right at an INTERSECTION facing a green light
rules.action: yield the right of way to PEDESTRIANS lawfully within a CROSSWALK and to vehicles lawfully within the INTERSECTION
rules.statement: WHEN turning left or right at an INTERSECTION facing a green light, the DRIVER MUST yield the right of way to PEDESTRIANS lawfully within a CROSSWALK and to vehicles lawfully within the INTERSECTION.
rules.penalty: Fail to yield: fine and 3 demerit points.

rules.title: Green arrow
rules.when: facing a GREEN ARROW at an INTERSECTION
rules.action: proceed only in the direction shown by the arrow, yielding to PEDESTRIANS and vehicles lawfully within the INTERSECTION or an adjacent CROSSWALK
rules.statement: WHEN facing a GREEN ARROW at an INTERSECTION, the DRIVER MUST proceed only in the direction shown by the arrow, yielding to PEDESTRIANS and vehicles lawfully within the INTERSECTION or an adjacent CROSSWALK.

rules.title: Advance green
rules.when: facing an ADVANCE GREEN at an INTERSECTION
rules.action: turn left, go straight through or turn right, yielding to PEDESTRIANS and vehicles lawfully within the INTERSECTION
rules.statement: WHEN facing an ADVANCE GREEN at an INTERSECTION, the DRIVER MAY turn left, go straight through or turn right, yielding to PEDESTRIANS and vehicles lawfully within the INTERSECTION.

rules.title: Amber arrow or amber after a protected turn
rules.when: approaching an INTERSECTION to turn AND an amber arrow or amber light is shown
rules.action: stop before the stop line, CROSSWALK or INTERSECTION
rules.unless: the stop cannot be made safely
rules.statement: WHEN approaching an INTERSECTION to turn AND an amber arrow or amber light is shown, the DRIVER MUST stop before the stop line, CROSSWALK or INTERSECTION, UNLESS the stop cannot be made safely.
rules.note: HTA s.144; after an amber left-turn arrow a left turn may continue on a solid green only by yielding to oncoming traffic.

rules.title: Right turn on red
rules.when: facing a red light at an INTERSECTION AND the DRIVER has come to a complete stop
rules.action: turn right, after yielding the right of way to PEDESTRIANS and to traffic lawfully using the INTERSECTION
rules.unless: a sign prohibits turning on a red light
rules.statement: WHEN facing a red light at an INTERSECTION AND the DRIVER has come to a complete stop, the DRIVER MAY turn right, after yielding the right of way to PEDESTRIANS and to traffic lawfully using the INTERSECTION, UNLESS a sign prohibits turning on a red light.
rules.penalty: Turning without stopping or yielding is a red-light offence: fine and 3 demerit points.

rules.title: Left turn on red from one-way to one-way
rules.when: facing a red light on a ONE-WAY HIGHWAY at an INTERSECTION with another ONE-WAY HIGHWAY carrying traffic to the left AND the DRIVER has come to a complete stop
rules.action: turn left, after yielding the right of way to PEDESTRIANS and to traffic lawfully using the INTERSECTION
rules.unless: a sign prohibits turning on a red light
rules.statement: WHEN facing a red light on a ONE-WAY HIGHWAY at an INTERSECTION with another ONE-WAY HIGHWAY carrying traffic to the left AND the DRIVER has come to a complete stop, the DRIVER MAY turn left, after yielding the right of way to PEDESTRIANS and to traffic lawfully using the INTERSECTION, UNLESS a sign prohibits turning on a red light.

rules.title: No turn on red sign
rules.when: facing a red light at an INTERSECTION AND a sign prohibits turning on a red light
rules.action: turn until the light turns green
rules.statement: WHEN facing a red light at an INTERSECTION AND a sign prohibits turning on a red light, the DRIVER MUST NOT turn until the light turns green.

rules.title: Pedestrian crossover or school crossing guard
rules.when: turning at or approaching a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER OR a crossing where a SCHOOL CROSSING GUARD displays a school crossing stop sign AND a PEDESTRIAN is on the crossing
rules.action: stop before entering the crossing and not proceed until the PEDESTRIAN and the SCHOOL CROSSING GUARD, if any, have completely crossed the ROADWAY
rules.statement: WHEN turning at or approaching a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER OR a crossing where a SCHOOL CROSSING GUARD displays a school crossing stop sign AND a PEDESTRIAN is on the crossing, the DRIVER MUST stop before entering the crossing and not proceed until the PEDESTRIAN and the SCHOOL CROSSING GUARD, if any, have completely crossed the ROADWAY.
rules.penalty: Fine of $150 to $500 (higher in community safety zones) and 4 demerit points.
rules.note: HTA s.140 (crossovers) and s.176 (school crossing guards); applies to turning drivers as well as through traffic.

rules.title: Yield to pedestrians when turning at unsignalized intersections
rules.when: turning at an INTERSECTION without traffic signals AND a PEDESTRIAN is crossing the ROADWAY the DRIVER is turning into
rules.action: yield to the PEDESTRIAN
rules.statement: WHEN turning at an INTERSECTION without traffic signals AND a PEDESTRIAN is crossing the ROADWAY the DRIVER is turning into, the DRIVER MUST yield to the PEDESTRIAN.
rules.note: Handbook guidance; at stop-sign intersections HTA s.136 also requires yielding to traffic in the intersection.

rules.title: Entering a highway from a driveway or private road
rules.when: about to turn onto a HIGHWAY from a private road or driveway
rules.action: yield the right of way to all traffic approaching on the HIGHWAY that is so close as to constitute an immediate hazard
rules.statement: WHEN about to turn onto a HIGHWAY from a private road or driveway, the DRIVER MUST yield the right of way to all traffic approaching on the HIGHWAY that is so close as to constitute an immediate hazard.
rules.penalty: Fail to yield: fine and 3 demerit points.

vague_terms.term: so close as to constitute an immediate hazard

rules.title: Pedestrians on the sidewalk at driveways
rules.when: turning into or out of a driveway, lane or private road across a sidewalk
rules.action: yield to PEDESTRIANS and CYCLISTS on the sidewalk or crossing the driveway
rules.statement: WHEN turning into or out of a driveway, lane or private road across a sidewalk, the DRIVER MUST yield to PEDESTRIANS and CYCLISTS on the sidewalk or crossing the driveway.

rules.title: No U-turn on a curve
rules.when: on a curve where approaching traffic cannot be seen within 150 metres in either direction
rules.action: make a U-TURN
rules.statement: WHEN on a curve where approaching traffic cannot be seen within 150 metres in either direction, the DRIVER MUST NOT make a U-TURN.

rules.title: No U-turn near a railway crossing
rules.when: on a railway crossing OR within 30 metres of a railway crossing
rules.action: make a U-TURN
rules.statement: WHEN on a railway crossing OR within 30 metres of a railway crossing, the DRIVER MUST NOT make a U-TURN.

rules.title: No U-turn near a hill crest
rules.when: on the approach to or near the crest of a grade where the vehicle cannot be seen by the driver of another vehicle approaching from either direction within 150 metres
rules.action: make a U-TURN
rules.statement: WHEN on the approach to or near the crest of a grade where the vehicle cannot be seen by the driver of another vehicle approaching from either direction within 150 metres, the DRIVER MUST NOT make a U-TURN.

rules.title: No U-turn near a bridge, viaduct or tunnel
rules.when: within 150 metres of a bridge, viaduct or tunnel AND the DRIVER's view is obstructed within that distance
rules.action: make a U-TURN
rules.statement: WHEN within 150 metres of a bridge, viaduct or tunnel AND the DRIVER's view is obstructed within that distance, the DRIVER MUST NOT make a U-TURN.

rules.title: No U-turn sign
rules.when: at a location where a sign prohibits U-TURNS
rules.action: make a U-TURN
rules.statement: WHEN at a location where a sign prohibits U-TURNS, the DRIVER MUST NOT make a U-TURN.
rules.penalty: Prohibited turn: fine and 2 demerit points.
rules.note: Municipal by-laws may also prohibit U-turns; the handbook tells drivers to check local by-laws.

rules.title: U-turn only with clear view and safe gap
rules.when: intending to make a U-TURN
rules.action: make the U-TURN unless the DRIVER can see well in both directions and the turn can be made without interfering with other traffic
rules.statement: WHEN intending to make a U-TURN, the DRIVER MUST NOT make the U-TURN unless the DRIVER can see well in both directions and the turn can be made without interfering with other traffic.

rules.title: Freeway median crossovers
rules.when: on a freeway or divided HIGHWAY AND a median crossover is signed for authorized or emergency vehicles only
rules.action: use the median crossover to make a U-TURN
rules.unless: the DRIVER is driving an authorized or emergency vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN on a freeway or divided HIGHWAY AND a median crossover is signed for authorized or emergency vehicles only, the DRIVER MUST NOT use the median crossover to make a U-TURN, UNLESS the DRIVER is driving an authorized or emergency vehicle.
rules.note: Based on regulatory signage on Ontario freeways; exact legal provision not confirmed.

rules.title: Three-point turn
rules.when: needing to turn around on a ROADWAY that is too narrow for a U-TURN
rules.action: make a THREE-POINT TURN only where it is legal, where the DRIVER can see clearly in both directions, and after signalling and checking for traffic, PEDESTRIANS and CYCLISTS
rules.statement: WHEN needing to turn around on a ROADWAY that is too narrow for a U-TURN, the DRIVER SHOULD make a THREE-POINT TURN only where it is legal, where the DRIVER can see clearly in both directions, and after signalling and checking for traffic, PEDESTRIANS and CYCLISTS.
rules.note: Handbook guidance, also tested on the road test; the handbook suggests driving around the block where possible.

rules.title: Large vehicles turning right
rules.when: a truck or bus ahead is turning right AND has swung wide or left a space on its right
rules.action: move into the space between the turning vehicle and the curb
rules.statement: WHEN a truck or bus ahead is turning right AND has swung wide or left a space on its right, the DRIVER MUST NOT move into the space between the turning vehicle and the curb.
rules.note: Handbook instruction; applies also to CYCLISTS.

rules.title: Allow room for large turning vehicles
rules.when: stopped at an INTERSECTION into which a large truck or bus is turning
rules.action: stay behind the stop line and leave room for the large vehicle to complete its turn
rules.statement: WHEN stopped at an INTERSECTION into which a large truck or bus is turning, the DRIVER SHOULD stay behind the stop line and leave room for the large vehicle to complete its turn.

rules.title: Cyclist left turn
rules.when: intending to turn left at an INTERSECTION
rules.action: either turn as a vehicle from the left lane after signalling, OR dismount and walk the bicycle across the CROSSWALKS
rules.statement: WHEN intending to turn left at an INTERSECTION, the CYCLIST MAY either turn as a vehicle from the left lane after signalling, OR dismount and walk the bicycle across the CROSSWALKS.
rules.note: Ontario cycling guidance published by MTO; bicycles may be ridden in crosswalks only where a crossride is marked.

rules.title: Lane choice to turn right at a multi-lane roundabout
rules.when: intending to turn right at a multi-lane ROUNDABOUT
rules.action: enter from the right-hand lane, as shown by signs and markings, and exit at the first exit
rules.statement: WHEN intending to turn right at a multi-lane ROUNDABOUT, the DRIVER MUST enter from the right-hand lane, as shown by signs and markings, and exit at the first exit.

rules.title: Lane choice to turn left or U-turn at a multi-lane roundabout
rules.when: intending to turn left OR make a U-TURN at a multi-lane ROUNDABOUT
rules.action: enter from the left-hand lane, travel counter-clockwise around the central island, and signal right before the exit
rules.statement: WHEN intending to turn left OR make a U-TURN at a multi-lane ROUNDABOUT, the DRIVER MUST enter from the left-hand lane, travel counter-clockwise around the central island, and signal right before the exit.

rules.title: Yield on entry and do not change lanes in a roundabout
rules.when: entering a ROUNDABOUT to turn
rules.action: yield to traffic already in the ROUNDABOUT and to PEDESTRIANS at the crossings, and stay in the chosen lane until exiting
rules.statement: WHEN entering a ROUNDABOUT to turn, the DRIVER MUST yield to traffic already in the ROUNDABOUT and to PEDESTRIANS at the crossings, and stay in the chosen lane until exiting.
rules.note: Handbook instruction; yield signs at ROUNDABOUT entries make yielding a legal requirement.
